newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:
Spokesman Thierry Daman said he had no information yet about whether the separatist crisis in the Comoros would affect EU policy on development aid to the region.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/750: Greece: 130 million ecus of Cohesion Fund subsidies for environment and transportation infrastructure projects
- IP/97/751: Commission authorises the formation of a joint venture between Thyssen Stahl and Krupp Hoesch Stahl AG in the flat steel products sector pursuant to the EC Merger Regulation.
- IP/97/752: Commission approves the acquisition of Tandem Computers by Compaq.
